description_en: Queries the information about a parent group based on a child group ID
description_zh: 调用该接口根据子分组ID查询父分组信息
name: QuerySuperDeviceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
